proposal:
Expose pytest.ParameterSet as a public annotation type

Export and document `pytest.ParameterSet` for helpers returning `pytest.param()`. Preserve tuple behavior, values, marks and IDs; identify the class as belonging to `pytest`; warn on direct construction while keeping factories and internal parametrization warning-free.

Added public-contract regression tests. Verification performed offline:

- Compilation and whitespace checks passed.
- Mark and expression suites: 292 passing cases and one expected failure across two runs. An example-path configuration failure passed on corrected rerun.
- Independent intent and artifact reviews passed.

Documentation builds, static type checking and the full repository suite were not run. Copying and unpickling also trigger the constructor warning. Changes remain in the checkout.
